name: Sober Grid
one_liner: Sober Grid is a peer support network app for addiction recovery, connecting you with others in recovery nearby and worldwide for 24/7 support and accountability.
best_for: People in recovery who benefit from peer support and community
Those looking for sober connections in their area
People who find AA/NA helpful but want additional digital support
Those in early recovery needing 24/7 access to peer support
People who want anonymous connection with others who understand addiction
not_for: Those needing professional addiction treatment or detox
People looking for clinical therapy or medication management
Those not comfortable with social features or community interaction
short_description: Peer support network for addiction recovery with location-based sober community and 24/7 support.
long_description: Sober Grid is a social support app designed specifically for people in addiction recovery. The app shows you other sober people nearby (with privacy controls), lets you post updates and support others, and includes a 'Burning Desire' button for moments when you're struggling. When you hit that button, peers and trained peer coaches can reach out with support. The platform includes sobriety tracking, but its main strength is the community aspect.
patient_summary: Sober Grid is like a social network just for people in recovery. See who's sober near you, share your journey, and get support when cravings hit. The 'Burning Desire' button connects you with peers when you're struggling.

pricing.notes: Free to use. Some premium features may be available.

privacy.notes: Location sharing is optional. Can use anonymously with username only.

seo.title: Sober Grid: Recovery Support Network App | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Sober Grid connects you with the recovery community. Find sober peers nearby, get 24/7 support, track sobriety. Free app for addiction recovery.

faqs.a: Yes. You can create a profile with just a username - no real name required. Location sharing is optional and adjustable. You control how much you share with the community.

faqs.q: What is the Burning Desire button?
faqs.a: When you're struggling with cravings or urges, tap the Burning Desire button to signal you need support. Peer coaches and community members can see this and reach out to help you through the moment.

faqs.q: Is Sober Grid only for alcohol addiction?
faqs.a: No. Sober Grid welcomes anyone in recovery from any addiction including alcohol, drugs, gambling, and more. The community includes people with various types of addictions.

faqs.q: How is Sober Grid different from AA meetings?
faqs.a: Sober Grid complements (not replaces) AA, NA, and other meetings. It provides 24/7 digital peer support between meetings, location-based connections, and immediate access when you can't get to a meeting.
